input.title: Add Copyright Stamp

content.title: Online Image Watermarker
content.p1: Secure your visual content by adding a copyright stamp or brand logo. Our Image Copyright Stamp tool lets you easily place watermarks on your photos to prevent unauthorized use.
content.p2: You can customize the text, font size, color, and opacity, or upload your own transparent logo file. Drag and drop the stamp directly onto the preview to position it perfectly.

text.title: Text Stamps
text.desc: Add copyright notices (©), dates, or your name with customizable fonts and colors.

logo.title: Logo Overlay
logo.desc: Upload your PNG logo and overlay it on your images with transparency support.

drag.title: Easy Positioning
drag.desc: Simply drag your watermark around the canvas to place it exactly where you want.

how_to.title: How to Watermark Photos
list: Enter your text or upload your logo file.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I remove the watermark later?
faq.a1: Watermarking is designed to be permanent on the exported image. Always keep your original file safe.
faq.a2: Yes, for best results, upload a PNG logo with a transparent background.
